title: Anger Speaks Louder? Exploring the Effects of AI Nonverbal Emotional Cues on Human Decision Certainty in Moral Dilemmas
reasoning: The paper is centered on evaluating human moral decision-making and certainty within the framework of ethical dilemmas (e.g., the Trolley Problem and scenarios involving hostages and ethnic conflict). It specifically investigates how AI emotional cues influence human moral thinking and ethical choices.
